subject: general
question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is** "Charishma."****
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **"**Charishma."
 
• The correct spelling is "Charisma."
 
• It means a powerful personal quality that some people have to attract and influence other people. (कुछ व्‍यक्तियों में दूसरों को आकर्षित व प्रभावित करने का प्रबल व्‍यक्तिगत गुण, आकर्षण)
 
 
• **Example**: *The president of the students’ union is not very clever, but he has great **charisma**__.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Dominate: **to be more powerful, important or noticeable than others. (अन्‍यों की अपेक्षा अधिक सशक्त और प्रभावशाली होना)
 
• **Elegant: **having a good or attractive style. (आकर्षक, रमणीक)
 
• **Cavalier: **showing a lack of proper concern; offhand. (उचित चिंता का अभाव दिखा रहा है; बेपरवाह)
